ai_commentary: EDR subscription revenue in MSP Channel NA came in $510K (6.1%) above budget. The driver is volume: net endpoint adds ran 4.2% ahead of plan, concentrated in partners enrolled in the Q3 migration promotion. Pricing held at plan. The run-rate benefit should carry into Q4; watch 90-day retention on promotion-driven adds.

EMEA distribution EDR revenue was $220K (10.2%) below budget. This is timing: onboarding for two new distributors slipped from September to October, so their opening book did not bill this month. Signed contracts and pipeline are unchanged. Expect recovery in October once both go live.
Managed SIEM revenue was $62K (9.7%) above budget, driven by volume. Attach rate among existing EDR partners rose to 14% against 12% planned, following the August bundle pricing.
APAC subscription revenue was $60K (6.1%) above budget, a volume variance from a faster-than-planned ramp at the new Australian distributor.

SOC contract analyst cost was $132K (34.7%) over budget. The driver is rate: overtime premiums after a mid-month spike in incident volume. Flagged for investigation because the data does not show whether the spike will persist; SOC leadership should confirm the staffing plan before the forecast is updated.

Cloud hosting was $125K (10.1%) over budget, driven by volume. Telemetry ingestion scales with endpoints under management, which ran ahead of plan (see EDR revenue). Cost per endpoint held flat, so the overage tracks revenue upside rather than inefficiency.
Support salaries were $8K (1.5%) over budget, within normal range. No commentary required.

Partner marketing events were $145K (46.8%) over budget due to timing. The fall MSP summit sponsorship was invoiced in September but budgeted in October. Full-year spend is unchanged; October should show an offsetting favorable variance.
Sales NA commissions were $90K (9.8%) over budget, a volume variance tied to bookings closing 8% above plan. Commission rates held at plan.

Sales EMEA salaries were $70K (9.2%) under budget because three open account executive roles remain unfilled. The saving is real, but it puts H1 EMEA bookings capacity at risk if the roles stay open past Q4.
Paid media was $38K (9.5%) under budget because the Q4 campaign launch moved to the first week of October.
Platform engineering salaries were $40K (1.4%) under budget, within normal range. No commentary required.
Engineering software tools were $26K (12.4%) over budget, a rate variance from the annual license true-up for developer seats. Flagged by the percent rule only; the dollar impact is small.
Security research contractors were $8K (8.9%) over budget for an additional malware-analysis engagement.

Audit fees were $85K (70.8%) over budget, a one-time item from expanded scope ahead of the SOC 2 Type II renewal. Flagged for investigation: confirm with the audit firm whether the added scope recurs in Q4 before closing this variance.
Outside counsel was $40K (22.2%) under budget due to timing. Two partner contract reviews moved to October; expect an offsetting overage next month.
Recruiting fees were $70K (26.9%) over budget. Volume driven: 11 agency placements against 7 planned, mainly SOC analysts for the APAC expansion.
IT software was $8K (5.3%) over budget, within normal range.
